item.title: Pezeshkian says he highlighted crimes of US and Israeli regime at UN
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Elaborating on his meetings and sessions at the 81st UN General Assembly, President Masoud Pezeshkian emphasized: "In my speech and all my meetings, I highlighted the plight of the Iranian people and the crimes committed by the Americans and the Zionists."

item.title: Iran’s Tayebi wins Asian Games shot put gold after 52-year wait
item.description: Nagoya, IRNA – Iranian shot putter Mohammadreza Tayebi won the men’s gold medal at the 2026 Asian Games in Nagoya, Japan, with a throw of 20.81 meters, breaking the Games record and ending a 52-year wait for Iran in the event.

item.title: Iran rejects speculation it plans to attack neighbors’ airports over US flight bans
